title: EE60057: Bioprocess Instrumentation
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Introduction to bioprocesses, definitions of biomass, cell mass, substrates,
nutrients, products. Density Measurement, hydrometers and absorption type;
Level and Flow Measurement, ultrasonic and laser anemometry; Viscosity and
Temperature Measurement; (Electrical) Conductivity Measurement; Densitometry,
Colorimetry, and Turbidity Measurement; Composition Measurement, electrochemical, thermal, kinetic methods; Chromatographic composition measurement; pH
and Water quality Measurement; Dissolved O2 and evolved CO2 Meas.; In-situ
Measurement of bio-process variables, Software sensors, stream inferencing of
variables; Actuators and Controllers.
